Rowan: not to be dramatic but we quietly crossed 1,000,000,000 monthly requests this morning. please sit down. :sparkles: :tada:
Mei: WAIT. that's... a billion? wow. congrats team!! :raised_hands: :clap:
Jonah: OK this deserves a weirdly classy celebration. proposals: 1) cupcakes with tiny LED candles, 2) a 10-min virtual orchestra (string quartet), 3) a low-key shoutout reel. vote with reactions.
Priya: cupcakes + reel. keep it intimate. also remote folks get a digital orchestra stream and a care box.
Theo: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheers-happy-l3vR9O6Y8gVh3z9Ek 
Rowan: quick logistics q @OpsBot  any problems with sending care boxes internationally?
OpsBot: Automated: international shipping available but customs delays possible. Recommend e-gift card alternative for APAC regions if deadline < 5 business days. FinanceOps notified for budget allocation.
Mei: timeline idea: cupcakes in SF + livestreamed 10-min string quartet at 4pm PT on Friday. care boxes/e-gift cards distributed by Thursday.
Jonah: sample ops snippet for ordering care kits I used before:
```
/create-carekit --kit "orchestra-box" --qty 120 --include "cupcake-voucher,mini-led,sticker" --ship-by 2026-10-01
```
Priya: also: tiny request  can everyone drop one short kudos in this thread for people who made the last quarter less painful? i'm compiling for the reel.
Theo: huge kudos to @Mei for the rollout choreography. her traffic-smoothing plan was chef's kiss. :chef_plate:
Rowan: shoutout to @Jonah for the observability work that let us spot the bottleneck early.
Mei: thanks!! extra kudos to infra on-call for holding the fort at 3am last week. you legends.
Jonah: remote folks: if you want a physical cupcake, DM me address; otherwise we'll send a voucher. opt-in only.
Rowan: also plotting a tiny "one-liner" scroll during the livestream where we read all the kudos. keep them under 10 words.
Priya: OpsBot: confirm no maintenance conflicts Friday 16:00-18:00 PT? want a clean window.
OpsBot: Automated: No maintenance scheduled during requested window. Monitoring: nominal.
PostBot: Automated: scheduled social announcement draft created for #announcements. Please review before publish.
Rowan: ok i'm genuinely proud. will make the event invite and the 30s thank-you. keep kudos coming and sleep if you can. :heart:
Mei: tiny final note: let's make the orchestra playlist include one very silly song. i nominate "Weird Startup Anthem" (you know the one).
Jonah: i'm writing the silly song into the running order. goodnight all, celebrate gently. :crescent_moon:
OpsBot: Automated: event safety checklist passed. Have fun!
